recognize_zh: 淋巴結中央一個邊界模糊的淡染區，內含胞質嗜酸性、核圓至卵圓且淡染的類上皮樣細胞及小血管，周圍被密集的小淋巴球包圍；右上角為被膜。此淡染區可能為退化濾泡中增生的濾泡樹突細胞或透明細胞群，需免疫染色確認。
features: Central ill-defined pale-staining zone composed of cells with ovoid vesicular nuclei and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm
Small vessels with plump endothelial cells within and around the pale zone
Scattered small lymphocytes infiltrating the pale zone
Dense surrounding sheet of small, dark lymphocytes
Capsule/perinodal tissue at the upper right
describe_en: Lymph node section shows an ill-defined pale-staining zone composed of cells with ovoid vesicular nuclei and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm, admixed with small vessels and scattered small lymphocytes, and surrounded by a dense population of small lymphocytes. The capsule is present at the upper right. The pale cells may represent a follicular dendritic cell proliferation within a regressed follicle, clusters of clear neoplastic T cells, or epithelioid histiocytes; this cannot be resolved on H&E alone. In context, findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma, and CD21/CD23, PD-1/CXCL13 and CD68 immunostains are recommended to characterize the pale zone.

ddx.vs: Granulomas are well circumscribed collections of CD68-positive epithelioid histiocytes, often with giant cells or necrosis, rather than CD21-positive dendritic meshworks around vessels.
Castleman follicles are regressed with onion-skin mantle zones and radially penetrating hyalinized vessels, but lack clonal TFH-phenotype T cells.

ddx.dx: Lymphoepithelioid (Lennert) variant of peripheral T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lennert lymphoma has numerous small epithelioid histiocyte clusters throughout the node with a CD8-predominant infiltrate and without expanded FDC meshworks.
